import pyttsx3
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

# Initialize the text-to-speech engine
engine = pyttsx3.init()
voices = engine.getProperty('voices')

# Function to convert text to speech
def convert_to_speech():
    text = text_box.get("1.0", tk.END).strip()
    if text:
        # Set selected voice
        selected_voice = voice_var.get()
        engine.setProperty('voice', voices[selected_voice].id)

        # Set speech rate
        rate = rate_slider.get()
        engine.setProperty('rate', rate)

        # Speak the text
        engine.say(text)
        engine.runAndWait()

# Create the main application window
root = tk.Tk()
root.title("Text-to-Speech Converter")
root.geometry("400x300")

# Text input
tk.Label(root, text="Enter Text:").pack(pady=5)
text_box = tk.Text(root, height=5, width=40)
text_box.pack(pady=5)

# Voice selection
tk.Label(root, text="Select Voice:").pack(pady=5)
voice_var = tk.IntVar(value=0)
voice_dropdown = ttk.Combobox(root, values=[voice.name for voice in voices], state="readonly")
voice_dropdown.pack(pady=5)
voice_dropdown.current(0)

# Speech rate
tk.Label(root, text="Speech Rate:").pack(pady=5)
rate_slider = ttk.Scale(root, from_=50, to=300, orient="horizontal")
rate_slider.set(150)
rate_slider.pack(pady=5)

# Convert button
convert_button = tk.Button(root, text="Convert to Speech", command=convert_to_speech)
convert_button.pack(pady=10)

# Run the application
root.mainloop()
